content.title: RTI | Distributed, physical AI systems work together as one
content.text: RTI Connext:A Real-Time Data Streaming Platform for Physical AI Harness Valuable Real-Time Data RTI Connext leads the transition to intelligent physical systems, with over 2,000 designs that ingest, analyze and act on real-time data in milliseconds. Deploy Microservices at Scale RTI Connext provides a highly modular and scalable platform that helps architects and developers quickly build and evolve physical systems. Reduce Integration Costs RTI Connext dramatically drives down the cost of software and systems integration, unlocking siloed data to enable smarter and faster decisions. RTI Connext: Real-Time Data Anywhere RTI Connext is the only real-time data streaming platform built for intelligent physical systems. Built on the Data Distribution Service (DDS®) standard, Connext unifies sensors, devices, algorithms and cloud infrastructure into a single, intelligent system that lets you leverage the power of real-time data anywhere in your network. As an alternative to broker-based solutions such as MQTT and Kafka, Connext has a decentralized architecture that reduces latency, increases throughput, and eliminates any single point of failure. CONNEXT HELPS TEAMS: Field Fast Accelerate development with powerful tools and AI assistance that speed up the deployment and integration of distributed systems. Run Anywhere Share data in real-time at the edge, between the edge and cloud, and with mobile assets — even over unreliable networks. Deploy Confidently Reduce project risk with a future-proof communications platform that is fully supported, safety certified and highly observable. The Connext Product Suite RTI Connext is a real-time data streaming platform with AI-powered capabilities. Its data-centric architecture simplifies and accelerates the development of intelligent and autonomous systems.
